value.rationale: Extend the common disclosure compiler with distinct disposal and post-disposal retention norms. Triggers remain explicit: a request alone is not termination, while termination of the agreement or service and an expressly stated completion-of-purpose endpoint support nda-16. Comprehensive return/destruction duties support nda-20 contradiction only when they cover Confidential Information and its copies and have no unresolved exception; express archival, compliance, or legally required copy rights support entailment. Unsupported sources remain unhandled.

source_examples.quote: Volunteer further agrees that upon termination of service with CCPDT, Volunteer shall return within ten (10) business days all documents, files, electronic or otherwise, and property comprising Confidential Information of CCPDT and all copies, electronic or otherwise, thereof relating in any way to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ business, or in any way obtained during the course of service.
Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law.
